### 3.2 Listing Requirements for Capital Expansion
Should Veramani seek to list on the JSE to raise growth capital, it must navigate the 2026 JSE Simplification Project rules. Ownership and Shareholding Structures

The current shareholding of the technology subsidiaries is centralized at the apex holding level rather than being held directly by the Veramani intermediate company [cite: 9].

- Bioniq (Pty) Ltd (2015/338013/07): 100% shareholding is held by Veralogix Holdings (Pty) Ltd [cite: 9].
- Vcom (Pty) Ltd (2024/916862/07): 100% shareholding is held by Veralogix Holdings (Pty) Ltd [cite: 9].
- Veramani’s Role: While not currently the direct shareholder in the CIPC registry, Veramani functions as the contractual manager and service provider [cite: 28, 29]. This is formalized through Management Services Agreements (MSAs), where Veramani provides the "AI Fabric" and technical oversight in exchange for management fees [cite: 20, 25].
